title: SEC2: per-test TLS cert gen in spawn_test_pair
description:
Each spawn_test_pair() call creates a fresh temp dir with a unique pid-subsecnanos suffix, so load_or_generate_cert always takes the generation branch (rcgen::generate_simple_self_signed — ECDSA keygen + self-sign). With the current 3 integration tests that is 3 cert generations per test run; as the suite grows this adds measurable wall time.

Location: crates/kithd/tests/harness.rs lines 139-146 (temp dir suffix), crates/kithd/src/tls.rs load_or_generate_cert (generation branch).

Fix direction: generate the cert once per test binary run (e.g. std::sync::OnceLock<(Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>)> holding the DER bytes) and pass the in-memory bytes into spawn_test_listener, bypassing the disk round-trip entirely for tests. Alternatively, use a fixed temp path shared across tests with a test-binary-scoped lock.
